gui.ore_yield.config.title: Ore Yield Configuration
gui.ore_yield.config.local_only: Edits are local-only; multiplayer servers are unchanged.
gui.ore_yield.category.general.help: Core Ore Yield behavior and dimension discovery.
gui.ore_yield.category.ores.help: Search and edit the configured vanilla and curated compatibility ores.
gui.ore_yield.category.generators.help: Stone Generator speed, yield multiplier, and anti-cheese controls.
gui.ore_yield.category.compatibility.hel: Optional ore compatibility and End-drop controls.
gui.ore_yield.category.mineral_pockets.h: Optional rare-pocket rewards and their category settings.
Controls for removing native ore features in newly generated chunks.
gui.ore_yield.category.advanced.help: Local configuration and file-only settings information.
gui.ore_yield.help.bad_luck_eliminator: Forces an eligible ore drop after enough misses. It is tracked per player.
gui.ore_yield.help.bad_luck_multiplier: Higher values shorten the number of misses before the pity drop is forced.
gui.ore_yield.help.auto_detect_dimension: Adds detected modded dimensions after a restart.
gui.ore_yield.help.generator_ore_yield_e: Allows normal Ore Yield rolls from marked Stone Generator output.
gui.ore_yield.help.enable_anti_cheese_me: Enables provenance tracking and Stone Generator content. Requires Ore Yield on every client after a restart.
gui.ore_yield.help.generator_ore_yield_c: Applied only to marked generator output when its yield is enabled.
gui.ore_yield.help.stone_generator_coold: Server ticks between generated blocks. Twenty ticks equal one second.
gui.ore_yield.help.allow_player_placed_e: Controls normal Ore Yield rolls on marked player-placed host blocks.
gui.ore_yield.help.allow_generator_autom: Allows automated harvesting of marked generator output.
gui.ore_yield.help.allow_generator_explo: Allows explosions to harvest marked generator output.
gui.ore_yield.help.enable_mod_compat: Scans compatible modded ores after restart. Auto-detected entries remain file-managed.
gui.ore_yield.help.enable_mod_compat_2: Enables the built-in Create and Mekanism compatibility profiles.
gui.ore_yield.help.mod_compat_2_ores_in_: Allows curated compatibility ores to roll from End Stone in the End.
gui.ore_yield.help.enable_vanilla_end_or: Allows the built-in vanilla ore set to roll from End Stone in the End.
gui.ore_yield.help.enable_mineral_pocket: Enables the optional independent rare mineral-pocket reward roll.
gui.ore_yield.help.mineral_pockets_end_e: Enables mineral pockets in the End. The Nether is always excluded.
gui.ore_yield.help.mineral_pockets_allow: Allows marked Stone Generator output to roll mineral pockets.
Allows non-player mining paths to roll mineral pockets.
gui.ore_yield.help.mineral_pocket_chance: Independent percentage chance per eligible break before category weights. Enter 100 for a guaranteed pocket roll.
gui.ore_yield.help.mineral_pocket_min_re: Metal and gem pockets choose at least this many distinct installed resources.
gui.ore_yield.help.mineral_pocket_max_re: Metal and gem pockets choose at most this many distinct installed resources.
gui.ore_yield.help.mineral_pocket_type: Cycles through Coal, Metal, Precious, Gem, and Ancient category settings.
gui.ore_yield.help.mineral_pocket_catego: Whether the displayed pocket category participates in the weighted roll.
Relative selection weight for the displayed category.
Minimum reward amount for every resource selected by this category.
Maximum reward amount for every resource selected by this category.
gui.ore_yield.help.remove_vanilla_ore_ge: Removes vanilla ore features from newly generated terrain only.
gui.ore_yield.help.remove_compatible_ore: When vanilla removal is enabled, also removes exact supported Create and Mekanism features.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.enabled: Disabled entries remain in the configuration but never roll.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.result_item: Registry ID of the item awarded by this ore entry.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.host_blocks: Comma-separated block IDs or #tag IDs that can produce this reward.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.min_count: Smallest normal reward stack before Fortune.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.max_count: Largest normal reward stack before Fortune.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.chance: Independent chance per eligible matching block, before Y-level weighting.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.min_y: Lowest Y level where this entry can roll.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.peak_y: Y level with the highest chance. Use -1 for a uniform range.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.max_y: Highest Y level where this entry can roll.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.fortune_type: NONE ignores Fortune; ORE uses normal ore multiplication; REDSTONE extends the amount range.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.xp_min: Minimum experience awarded for a successful normal ore drop.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.xp_max: Maximum experience awarded for a successful normal ore drop.
gui.ore_yield.help.ore.dimension: Dimension registry ID. Leave blank only for entries intentionally usable in any dimension.
gui.ore_yield.config.compatibility.resta: Auto-detection changes take effect after a restart.
gui.ore_yield.config.anti_cheese.restart: Startup-only: enable it on the server and every modded client, then restart all of them.
gui.ore_yield.config.world_generation.ne: World-generation removal affects new chunks only; already-generated ore blocks remain unchanged.
gui.ore_yield.config.advanced.file_only: Recipe ingredients, custom additional ores, and dimension lists remain file-only to avoid unsafe free-form edits.
gui.ore_yield.config.advanced.cancel_not: Cancel and Back never write your pending edits.
gui.ore_yield.config.ores.search.help: Searches ore names, namespaces, and result-item IDs.
gui.ore_yield.config.ores.empty: No editable ore entries match this search.
gui.ore_yield.config.ores.row_help: Edit %s. The row shows enabled state, dimension, and chance.
gui.ore_yield.config.ores.read_only: This auto-detected entry is currently managed from the TOML file and cannot be persisted by this editor.
gui.ore_yield.config.ore_editor.help: Editing the persisted Ore Yield definition for %s.
gui.ore_yield.config.ore_editor.back.hel: Returns to the ore list without writing this ore's pending changes.
gui.ore_yield.config.scroll_up.help: Shows earlier settings or ore rows.
gui.ore_yield.config.scroll_down.help: Shows later settings or ore rows.
gui.ore_yield.config.reload.help: Discards pending edits and reloads ore_yield.toml from disk.
gui.ore_yield.config.reset_section.help: Restores this section to the values loaded when this screen was opened.
gui.ore_yield.config.save.help: Validates and writes all pending edits to the local TOML file.
gui.ore_yield.config.save_close.help: Writes the local TOML file, then returns to the previous screen.
gui.ore_yield.config.unsaved_notice: Hover a setting for help. Save writes local changes; Cancel discards them.
gui.ore_yield.validation.invalid_number: Enter a finite number within the allowed range.
gui.ore_yield.validation.invalid_integer: Enter a whole number within the allowed range.
gui.ore_yield.validation.invalid_range: The peak height must be inside the configured minimum and maximum Y range.
gui.ore_yield.validation.invalid_id: Enter a valid namespace:path registry ID.
